title: ID0455600-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / S5 170003680] No Converters in DC3 and DC4
description:
Reported behavior/issue -
No converters in DC3 and DC4 because of KF214 failure.
Solution: Replace KF214
Note from TS: Wait for KF214 and support external colleague onsite
Note from TS: Waiting for spare parts

Hello Nick, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Since we are waiting for the spare part, I will proceed to close the ticket.

If you need assistance again, just open a new ticket and refer my name so that we can support again.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
